purpose: v9 rig-cogen convergence run at the measured operating point (100k; the 300k v8 run showed re-freezing and alignment collapse beyond ~100k). Caption setting (canonical) is selected by the winner rule declared BEFORE the caption-pair results existed (configs/v9_convergence_winner_rule.json): the arm with the higher retrieval_top5 at its 40k milestone; tie goes to canonical. Fresh 100k cosine; milestone evals at 10k/20k/40k/60k/80k/100k with the retrieval metric chained. Single seed.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.

matched_control: the 40k caption-pair arms and the v8 100k pixel-only run
